bm25.tokenizer: ASCII identifiers and numbers; camel and underscore split; lowercase; retain full identifier too

symbol: exact identifier/FQN token intersection only; no paraphrase expansion

chunks.unit: AST function implementation including decorators and docstrings
chunks.long_single_line: retain source bytes; record encoder truncation
chunks.dedup: function-level first hit for metrics; source-line dedup for context

limits: Curated registered qrels, not universal recall. No parameter/label changes after ranking.
